## HIGH IMPACT

No high-impact breaking changes were identified in this release. No CSS custom properties were renamed or removed, no web component element names changed, no shadow DOM slots or parts were removed, and no card-mod-targeted selectors were invalidated.

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `hui-sections-view` (Sections View Layout)

**What changed:** In `src/panels/lovelace/views/hui-sections-view.ts`, the padding calculation for column-count determination was moved from `.container` to a new `.wrapper` element. Specifically:

```diff
- const paddingLeft = parsePx(containerStyle.paddingLeft);
- const paddingRight = parsePx(containerStyle.paddingRight);
+ const paddingLeft = parsePx(wrapperStyle.paddingLeft);
+ const paddingRight = parsePx(wrapperStyle.paddingRight);
```

A new `.wrapper` element now wraps the `.container` inside `hui-sections-view`'s shadow DOM, and the sections view template was substantially reworked. The full diff (truncated) also shows changes to the sidebar stacking behavior at narrow widths (`Stack the sidebar when only one column fits`).

**LCARS rules affected:** The ha-lcars theme does not currently inject CSS directly into `hui-sections-view`'s shadow DOM (there is no `hui-sections-view$` card-mod rule), so the column count re-calculation itself does not break any existing LCARS rule. However, if the theme ever relies on `.container` having horizontal padding to drive column layout in sections view, that assumption is now invalid — padding lives on `.wrapper`.

The sidebar-stacking behavior change (stacking the sidebar when only one column fits) may affect the visual appearance of the LCARS sidebar on narrow-but-not-mobile viewports, since LCARS's `card-mod-sidebar-yaml` and `card-mod-root-yaml` include `@media screen and (max-width: 870px)` breakpoints. If the new sections-view column logic causes the sidebar to stack at a different effective viewport width than 870px, the LCARS media query thresholds may not align with HA's new stacking trigger.

**Specific LCARS selectors potentially affected:**
- `card-mod-sidebar-yaml .: |` — the `@media screen and (max-width: 870px)` block, which controls `.ha-scrollbar::before`, `ha-menu-button` display, `ha-icon-button` margins, and the clock `::after` content on small screens.
- `card-mod-root-yaml div.header: |` — the `@media screen and (max-width: 870px)` block controlling `ha-menu-button` display and `.main-title` margin.

**Suggested fix:** Monitor whether the new sidebar-stacking logic triggers the sidebar stack at a different pixel width than 870px. If the sections-view column calculation now produces a single-column layout at a wider viewport than expected, the LCARS `@media` breakpoints may need adjustment. No immediate code change is required, but test the theme on a viewport width between ~600px and 870px to confirm the mobile-mode sidebar CSS fires at the correct breakpoint.

### Component: `home-overview-view-strategy` (Home Strategy Sidebar Labels)

**What changed:** Two localization keys were removed from the sidebar section definition in `src/panels/lovelace/strategies/home/home-overview-view-strategy.ts`:

```diff
- content_label: hass.localize("ui.panel.lovelace.strategy.home.home"),
- sidebar_label: hass.localize("ui.panel.lovelace.strategy.home.summaries"),
```

The `content_label` and `sidebar_label` properties are no longer passed when constructing the home overview strategy's sidebar section config.

**LCARS rules affected:** The ha-lcars theme does not inject CSS targeting these label strings directly, and no LCARS card-mod rule targets `content_label` or `sidebar_label` as CSS selectors or custom properties. However, if any LCARS user is running a home-strategy dashboard that visually relied on those labels being present (e.g., a `::before`/`::after` generated-content rule that expected the label text to populate a slot), those labels will now be absent.

**Suggested fix:** No theme-level fix is needed — this is an upstream content removal, not a structural CSS change. Users relying on the home strategy sidebar labels should be aware the labels are gone. No LCARS CSS requires updating.

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `home-assistant.ts` (App Initialization Logic)

**What changed:** The `hass.user` change-detection logic was refined to only trigger on the initial `null → user` population rather than on every reference change. This affects how quickly the launch screen swaps and the admin guard fires, but has no visual CSS effect.

**LCARS rules affected:** None. No action needed.

---

### Component: Notification Stacking / Toast (`ha-toast`, `notification-manager`)

**What changed:** Notification stacking was fixed (`Fix notification stacking`, `#53486`). The `ha-toast` component and `notification-manager` were modified.

**LCARS rules affected:** The ha-lcars theme does not currently inject CSS into `ha-toast`'s shadow DOM. The `--lcars-ui-tertiary` variable drives `lcars-sidebar-notification-color` and badge colors but those are sidebar-level variables unrelated to the toast stack position.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. Optionally, the theme could add a `card-mod-toast-yaml` or equivalent rule to style `ha-toast` notifications in LCARS colors, but this is not required.

---

### Component: Sidebar Tab Switcher (`ha-tab-group`)

**What changed:** `Only show the sidebar tab switcher when its tabs are labelled` (`#53508`). The tab switcher in the sidebar is now conditionally rendered based on whether tabs have labels.

**LCARS rules affected:** The `card-mod-root-yaml` injects into `ha-tab-group$` and `ha-tab-group-tab$` with rules for background colors, border, and selected-state coloring. If the tab switcher is not rendered when tabs are unlabelled, the LCARS `ha-tab-group` styles will simply have no element to apply to — a no-op rather than a visual break.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. The existing `ha-tab-group$` and `ha-tab-group-tab$` rules in `card-mod-root-yaml` are safe; they will silently do nothing when the tab switcher is hidden.
